headline: Winged Kuriboh
title: Winged Kuriboh Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Winged Kuriboh. What is it? It is a Level one LIGHT Fairy with three hundred attack. In GX, Yugi gave this card to Jaden. What does it do? If it is destroyed on the field and sent to the Graveyard, you take no battle damage for the rest of that turn. How do you use it? Put it in Defense Position as a wall that saves you for a full turn.
